honolulu.notes: Welcome home to a thoughtfully designed space where comfort, connection, and everyday living come naturally. Located in the prestigious Portlock neighborhood of Hawaii Kai, this 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of functionality, space, and island living. Boasting over 2,000 square feet of interior living area, the home's unique open-concept floor plan provides generous living and dining spaces ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Spacious bedrooms provide flexibility for family, a home office, or multigenerational living, while three separate gated yard areas offer private outdoor spaces off each wing of the home. Step outside to your own private tropical retreat featuring a swimming pool and beautifully landscaped yard, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining, relaxation, and year-round enjoyment. From the spacious gathering areas to the private backyard, this home was made for making memories. Located in one of East Honolulu's most coveted neighborhoods and just moments from both Hawaii Kai's shopping centers and desirable beach access points, this Portlock home offers the lifestyle, space, and comfort you've been searching for.

marketReferenceOutliers.address: 459 Portlock Rd, Apt A, Honolulu, HI 96825

wystone.notes:
Privately situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Porter Ranch’s most desirable neighborhoods, this thoughtfully
updated two-story residence offers approximately 2,501 square feet of inviting living space with three spacious bedrooms, three
bathrooms, and an expansive 8,428-square-foot lot. From the moment you step inside, you’ll appreciate the abundance of natural
light streaming through newer dual-pane windows and sliding glass doors, creating a bright, open atmosphere throughout the
home. Fresh interior paint in warm, inviting tones, upgraded wood-look flooring, newer plush carpeting, and custom built-ins add
both style and functionality. The magazine-worthy designer kitchen is thoughtfully appointed for both everyday living and
entertaining, featuring rich granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, beautiful glass display cabinetry, generous storage,
and abundant counter space. Seamlessly opening to the main living areas, it serves as the true heart of the home.
The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers multiple living and dining spaces, providing flexibility for entertaining, working from
home, or simply relaxing with family. Upstairs, the spacious bedrooms offer comfort and privacy, while the versatile layout easily
accommodates a variety of lifestyles. Outside, the oversized backyard offers endless possibilities to create your own private
retreat. Whether you envision an outdoor kitchen, lush gardens, a sparkling pool, or a play space, there is plenty of room to bring
your vision to life.
